system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: At 13:41 UTC, maria.lopez ran PowerShell to compress \\FILE-HD-01\Shared\Clients into C:\Users\maria.lopez\AppData\Local\Temp\c.zip; Sysmon recorded creation of that archive shortly afterward.
The same user launched Chrome to https://sendbox-files.io/ shortly before the large outbound transfer.

At 13:48 UTC, the proxy recorded approximately 51 MB sent from WS-MLOPEZ-01 to sendbox-files.io through a successful HTTPS tunnel; Zeek recorded approximately 51 MB of originating bytes for the corresponding proxy connection.
The network connection is attributed to Chrome running as maria.lopez, consistent with the browser launch to sendbox-files.io.
The sequence of archiving the Clients share, opening an unapproved file-sharing site, and sending about 51 MB there strongly supports intentional data exfiltration.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records a CONNECT tunnel and byte counts, but the supplied records do not expose the HTTPS upload request or its payload; they do not directly link c.zip to the transferred bytes.
The supplied sensor-status information reports a winsec and Sysmon collection outage for WS-LPARK-01 from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC; it does not list WS-MLOPEZ-01 as affected.
claims_not_established: The exact contents and size of c.zip, and whether the archive contained sensitive client data.
Whether the transferred bytes were c.zip or another payload, and whether the destination retained or processed the data.
Whether maria.lopez had authorization or a legitimate business reason to create and transfer the archive.
additional_evidence_needed: Preserve and examine c.zip, including its hash, size, contents, and creation/access metadata.
Collect browser history, upload-page artifacts, and endpoint telemetry that could tie the archive to the outbound transfer.
Obtain destination-side records, if available, to confirm the uploaded object and whether it was retained.
Confirm with maria.lopez and the relevant data owner whether this transfer was authorized; review file-server access/audit records for the Clients share.
